name: Stakeholders Checklist
one_liner: Did we actually do the stakeholder work this phase? Yes/No, phase by phase.
purpose: The Stakeholders Checklist is a document created to help deal with stakeholders during the lifecycle of the project. Its main purpose is to support the Project Manager in verifying whether the activities related to the key stakeholders were performed as planned. It is reviewed and customised at the start of each phase and used to identify specific actions to be taken at specific moments.
created_in: Initiating Phase; reviewed and customised at the start of every phase
approved_by: Not formally approved — completed by the PM and signed by the named phase-exit reviewer
gate: Every phase gate — RfP, RfE and RfC
